name: The Earth is round
summary:
Dive into the heart of Antiquity and discover how scholars revealed that the Earth is spherical.

Imagined by the Space Department and the Time and Space Laboratory teams at the Paris Observatory, this immersive experience places you in the shoes of great thinkers of ancient times and invites you to experiment for yourself.
